title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 107
description: Ten questions on Psalms 107: the redeemed gathered from all lands, wanderers, prisoners, the sick and sailors who cried to Yahweh and were saved.

questions.text: From where did Yahweh gather the redeemed?
questions.explanation: Psalms 107:3 says he gathered them out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

answers.text: Only from the islands of the sea
From the east, west, north and south
Only from the land of Ham

questions.text: What did those who wandered in the desert not find?
questions.explanation: Psalms 107:4 says they wandered in the wilderness in a desert way and found no city to live in.

answers.text: A way back to the sea

questions.text: Why did some sit in darkness and in the shadow of death?
questions.explanation: Psalms 107:10-11 says they sat in darkness, bound in affliction and iron, because they rebelled against the words of God.

answers.text: They rebelled against the words of God

questions.text: What kind of gates has Yahweh broken?
questions.explanation: Psalms 107:16 says he has broken the gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.

questions.text: What does Yahweh send to heal those who are afflicted?
questions.explanation: Psalms 107:20 says he sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

questions.text: Who see Yahweh's deeds and his wonders in the deep?
questions.explanation: Psalms 107:23-24 says those who go down to the sea in ships and do business in great waters see his deeds and his wonders in the deep.

answers.text: Shepherds who watch flocks in the fields
Priests who serve in the temple
Those who go down to the sea in ships
Those who dig wells in the desert

questions.text: In the storm, the sailors stagger like what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 107:27 says they reel back and forth and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.

questions.text: After the storm becomes calm, where does Yahweh bring the sailors?
questions.explanation: Psalms 107:30 says they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

questions.text: Why does Yahweh turn a fruitful land into a salt waste?
questions.explanation: Psalms 107:34 says he turns a fruitful land into a salt waste for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

answers.text: To make room for new vineyards
Because the rivers dried up by themselves
For the wickedness of those who dwell in it

questions.text: He lifts the needy out of their affliction and increases their families like what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 107:41 says he lifts the needy out of their affliction and increases their families like a flock.
